Your role will encompass strategic planning, cross-functional initiatives management, executive reporting, special project execution, and the synthesis of complex information to support Public Sector objectives and growth. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold builders and sharp problem-solvers who are wired to deliver great outcomes. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. The DevX team’s mission is to build and operate the core developer infrastructure at Robinhood. Our team owns and scales the systems that thousands of engineers rely on daily, partnering with software developers across the company to make development fast, reliable, and cost-efficient! As a Staff Software Developer, you will act as a technical leader for our build and developer infrastructure, driving the strategy and execution of the systems thousands engineers depend on every day. Your work will span our build systems, CI pipelines, and remote development environments, ensuring engineers can code, test, and build with speed, safety, and reliability at scale. In this role, you will collaborate with teams across Robinhood to eliminate developer friction and raise the bar for engineering productivity. This is a high-visibility leadership opportunity to shape our developer ecosystem and set new standards of engineering efficiency! This role is based in our Toronto, ON office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Architect the long-term technical strategy and roadmap for our core developer infrastructure, including CI, SCM, and development environments. Build and maintain robust, scalable infrastructure capable of handling increasing operational loads with a relentless focus on speed, safety, and reliability. Lead the strategy for developer onboarding and development environments, reducing time-to-first-commit and making it effortless for engineers to be productive. Collaborate with engineering teams to standardize build and CI patterns, eliminate developer friction, and champion high engineering standards across the organization. Provide technical mentorship to engineers across the team, conducting rigorous design reviews and establishing best-practice operational guidelines. What you bring Extensive experience designing, scaling, and operating critical developer infrastructure or high-volume build/CI systems in production environments. Deep subject-matter expertise in modern build systems (such as Bazel) and distributed or remote build execution, with a strong understanding of CI/CD at scale. Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with a track record of building reliable, maintainable system software. Proven ability to guide complex technical initiatives from conception to completion, aligning technical execution with company-wide objectives. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to advocate for build/CI tooling adoption, drive onboarding improvements, and mentor other engineers. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. If you require a specific accommodation during the application or interview process due to a physical or mental condition, please complete this Applicant Accommodation Form to notify our team. The form should only be completed if you need a specific accommodation. Vacancy Notice: This job posting represents an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. Base Pay Range: Toronto, ON $200,000 — $235,000 CAD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. items.description: Perplexity is looking for a dynamic and innovative contributor to join our team to help advance the business, improve the products we’re building, and revolutionize the way people search and interact with the internet. This unique role offers significant responsibility to apply and strengthen your technical background and combine your legal experience, and offers growth potential in other areas of an in-house practice group. ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY We seek a technical lead to join our legal operations team to drive infrastructure development across our legal and operations team and support our ambitious growth trajectory within our rapidly growing AI technology company. This unique role will report to the Legal Operations Manager and partner with the General Counsel and VP, Operations on strategic planning, architecting, delivering, and transforming high-volume legal workflows into scalable, automated systems. We're seeking a sharp, innovative technical operations professional with strong business judgment, practical problem-solving skills, and a deep understanding of high-growth startup environments. Ideally, this person also brings legal expertise alongside technical know-how. You’ll build scalable processes and establish foundational systems that will scale with our growth. Success requires someone who is inquisitive, has entrepreneurial drive, and the agility to thrive in our fast-paced environment while shaping our non-technical orgs from the ground up at a cutting-edge AI technology company. ABOUT THE ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES - Architect and build Perplexity's Legal and Operations Engineering platform — a coherent stack of agents, workflows, and evaluation infrastructure that replaces manual, high-volume legal work across commercial contracting, e-discovery, enterprise redlining, subsidiary governance, vendor onboarding, and litigation and matter management. - Own the enterprise contracting automation system end-to-end. - Ship the in-product legal surfaces built on Perplexity and Computer itself - Consolidate today's ad-hoc legal bots, prompts, and scripts into a documented, observable, and reusable platform with clear conventions for personas, tools, evals, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns. - Serve as the technical partner to the General Counsel. Translate complex, judgment-heavy legal workflows into engineered systems, and translate engineering constraints back to non-technical stakeholders. - Evaluate, retire, or replace third-party tools where a purpose-built internal system gives us a structural advantage. - Be the case study for forward-deployed engineering in non-engineering functions at Perplexity. Success here becomes the playbook for Legal, Recruiting, People, Workplace, and Operations. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - 3+ years of backend software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production systems at meaningful scale. - A working knowledge of legal concepts, with some experience in legal operations or paralegal work is desired. - Strong business judgment and practical problem-solving; comfortable making operational calls with incomplete information and calibrating risk in real time. - Track record building scalable processes and foundational systems from scratch, not maintaining a mature function. - Fluency with modern legal tech and AI tools; disciplined human-in-the-loop practices. - Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to work directly with senior legal, finance, and executive stakeholders. - Entrepreneurial drive, intellectual curiosity, and agility to thrive in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE - Prior experience at an AI-native, SaaS, or consumer technology company operating at Perplexity’s pace. - Familiarity with e-billing platforms (e.g., Brightflag), matter management, CLM, and entity management systems. - Comfort with ambiguity, rapid context-switching, and a builder mentality.

items.title: Researcher, Multimodal Safety
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI is at the center of some of the highest-impact multimodal work in AI. ChatGPT serves a massive global audience, and enables diverse interactions via text, speech, and visuals. As interactive surfaces grow, models also need to adapt to emerging harm, understand user intent and situational context, and respond appropriately. The Chat and Multimodal Safety team is responsible for ensuring that OpenAI’s increasingly multimodal models and products behave safely across these experiences. We develop the research, training methods, and evaluations needed to make these experiences safe. Our work sits at the frontier of responsibly deploying powerful AI, in close partnership with Personal AGI, io, model training, and product teams. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Researcher on the Chat and Multimodal Safety team, you will help shape how frontier models perceive and reason the world, and translate that understanding into safe behavior. We’re looking for people who combine deep technical expertise with strong safety judgment. Strong candidates often bridge perception and language: they may have built vision-language models, worked on modality fusion or image encoders, developed multimodal post-training or evaluations, or advanced safety for image, video, or audio systems. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Define and advance multimodal safety research for text, vision, and audio, connecting perception and semantic understanding to safe model behavior. - Build training and evaluation methods for VLMs, including post-training, safety evals, and interventions that help models respond safely and appropriately in varied contexts. - Collaborate closely with Personal AGI, Consumer Devices, and product/model teams to translate research into safer ambient, embedded, and personalized multimodal experiences. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have a track record of building or advancing multimodal models, with depth in vision-language models, video understanding, image generation, audio, or multimodal reasoning—and fluency across both perception and language. - Understand how multimodal systems work end to end, from encoders, projection layers, and modality fusion to cross-modal reasoning, scaling, and inference tradeoffs. - Have improved frontier model behavior through post-training, using approaches such as SFT, RL, data curation, synthetic data, evaluation, and rigorous error analysis. - Bring strong research and engineering judgment to open-ended safety problems: you can form testable hypotheses, design decisive experiments and evaluations, diagnose model failures, and translate findings into robust improvements. The Global Safety Response Operations team within the org provides 24/7 coverage for user safety, risk, and regulatory escalations across OpenAI’s products, handling the highest-priority cases that require human judgment and rapid response. The team operates as the core escalations management and delivery arm of OpenAI’s safety operations, ensuring that our products remain safe and aligned with our policies while enabling timely, empathetic, and consistent user support. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive content, including material that is sexual, violent, or otherwise disturbing. You’ll work across subject matter areas, systems, and processes to ensure operational excellence, develop process improvements and automations, and surface insights and trends. items.title: Product Marketing Manager, Science
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Product Marketing Manager, Science, you will serve as the strategic bridge between Mistral's Science organisation and our Marketing, Product and Go-to-Market teams. Your mission is to translate cutting-edge AI research into compelling product narratives, technical positioning and customer-facing content that helps developers, enterprise buyers and industry influencers understand the value of our models. You will work closely with researchers and engineers to provide industry-leading thought leadership, bring new models and capabilities to market, and ensure launches are technically accurate, commercially relevant, and easy to understand. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep technical curiosity with exceptional communication and storytelling skills. WHAT YOU WILL DO DRIVE TECHNICAL PRODUCT MARKETING - Develop positioning, messaging and technical narratives for Mistral's foundation models and research innovations. - Translate complex AI concepts—including pre-training, post-training, reasoning, evaluation and inference—into clear, compelling customer value. - Partner with Science, Product and Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure technical accuracy and market relevance. LEAD TECHNICAL LAUNCHES - Own the technical marketing components of model launches, including launch messaging, technical blogs, documentation, presentations and demos. - Collaborate with Product Marketing, Communications and Developer Relations to deliver cohesive go-to-market campaigns. CREATE WORLD-CLASS TECHNICAL CONTENT - Produce technical blogs, whitepapers, benchmark analyses, presentations, demo videos, webinars and workshops. - Build sales enablement materials that help technical and commercial teams confidently communicate Mistral's differentiated capabilities. - Develop content that supports enterprise buyers, developers and AI practitioners throughout their evaluation journey. ENABLE INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL AUDIENCES - Equip Sales, Solutions Engineering and Partnerships teams with technical messaging, competitive insights and customer-facing assets. - Support customer briefings, executive meetings and strategic technical conversations. - Partner closely with Developer Relations and Solutions Architects to ensure consistent technical messaging across all customer touchpoints. REPRESENT MISTRAL'S TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP - Support analyst briefings, technical advisory boards and industry events. - Help position Mistral as a thought leader by communicating advances in frontier AI research to external audiences. WHO YOU ARE EXPERIENCE - 5+ years in Product Marketing, Technical Product Marketing, Solutions Engineering or Technical Marketing within AI, machine learning, cloud infrastructure or enterprise software. - Experience working closely with research or engineering teams to launch highly technical products. - Strong understanding of large language models and modern AI systems. Experience with model training, evaluation, or inference is highly desirable. TECHNICAL SKILLS - Ability to quickly understand complex technical concepts and translate them into clear business value. - Excellent written communication with experience creating technical content for both technical and executive audiences. - Familiarity with enterprise AI deployments, APIs, cloud infrastructure and developer ecosystems. MINDSET - Highly collaborative and comfortable working across Science, Product, Marketing and Go-to-Market teams. - Curious, analytical and passionate about frontier AI. - Low ego, pragmatic and excited by fast-moving environments. ACADEMIC BACKGROUND Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, AI, or a related technical discipline is preferred. IT WOULD BE IDEAL IF YOU - Have experience working directly with AI researchers or ML engineering teams. - Have launched AI models, developer platforms, or highly technical enterprise products. - Have created technical product marketing content that influenced customer adoption or enterprise purchasing decisions. - Enjoy translating breakthrough research into stories that resonate with customers. - Are based in Paris, willing to relocate, or open to traveling regularly to our Paris office. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
